title: GTA 6 Radio Stations: Every Station and Its Hosts (V-Rock, Flash FM and More)
desc: GTA 6's radio stations and who hosts them: Lindsey Buckingham on V-Rock, Bad Bunny on Cocoteo FM, Keith Richards on Gloriana Blues and more. From NME, PC Gamer and GameSpot.
lede: GTA 6 has 20+ radio stations (guides count between 21 and 23), and Rockstar cast big names as hosts: Lindsey Buckingham on V-Rock, Bad Bunny on Cocoteo FM, Keith Richards on Gloriana Blues Radio and more. Here's who hosts what.

Hosts as reported by NME and cross-checked with PC Gamer and GameSpot's station lists. A few stations are listed differently between guides, so we left those out until it's settled.
Yes: V-Rock, the rock station from Vice City (2002), returns, hosted by Fleetwood Mac's Lindsey Buckingham and Michael McDonald (NME).
Can I use GTA 6 radio songs in my videos?
Careful: the songs are licensed music, and YouTube's Content ID will usually claim them. If you record gameplay to post, turn the radio off in the audio settings.
note: Station lists can change with updates. Checked November 24, 2026. Vice Replay is a fan site, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
